newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras says unable to move on shr issue.
newsitem.headline: Telebras says unable to move on shr issue.

text.p: Telecom group Telebras said it cannot issue new shares under a contested 1990 share subscription because a final court ruling has not been made.
"At the current stage, it is not sufficient for Telebras to take a decision" on the subscription, the company said in a statement.
"The company's management is awaiting a complete decision by the judiciary to know the steps that are to be taken."
A regional federal court backed Telebras' 13.7 billion share subscription, rejecting a government appeal lodged in 1992 to block the issue based on allegations that the share price was undervalued.
The Brazilian government, the major shareholder in Telebras, has 30 days to appeal the ruling, which was published Thursday, to the Supreme Court.
Any appeal is likely to reach the court in February due to the Christmas and New Year's court recesses, so a final decision is expected to take months.
